long_biography.plain_text:
William Grant and his nine children built the Glenfiddich distillery in Dufftown, where the first spirit ran on Christmas Day 1887. Five generations later, his great-great-grandson Grant Glenn Gordon serves as non-executive chairman under the working name Glenn Gordon. Before taking the chair in 2012, he had been the group's managing director.

The company remains entirely family owned and has grown around Glenfiddich, The Balvenie and Grant's, later broadening into gin, Irish whiskey, rum and liqueurs. Gordon supports the board and management team rather than acting as day-to-day chief executive. Companies House records him as a director and a person with significant influence or control over the current holding company.
